note: Wildmoot Hide Hunter (unit identity, Wildmoot): lean hunched boar-kin archer with floppy ears, small tusks, clay brow stripes, a leather cap with an ochre-stitched brim and a three-feather fan on the left, a hide cloak and quiver on the back, a team jerkin and the order bow in the left hand. Tier I only. No back flag.
